propositions: A new generator script must read the config schema, deprecation registry, and secret-name inventory to produce fully-generated configuration and security reference docs that stay synchronized with source truth
The generator must preserve docs/config.md unchanged so that all existing content-asserting tests and anchor deep links continue to work without modification

The generated docs must include required topic sections for precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, and MCP/CLI exposure
A --check drift mode must detect when generated docs become stale and fail tests, supporting CRLF-safe newline normalization for cross-platform consistency
Both generated docs must be registered in test registries and navigation documentation with self-announcing banners naming the exact generator command
